tests.name: basic-sales-report
tests.quote: SELECT 는 먼저 머리줄 한 줄을 출력하고 그 뒤에 결과 행을 한 줄에 하나씩 출력한다.
input: CREATE TABLE sales (region STRING, item STRING, qty INT)
INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('east', 'pen', 3), ('west', 'ink', 5)
INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('east', 'ink', 2)
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(qty) FROM sales
SELECT region, SUM(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY region
SELECT item, COUNT(*), MIN(qty), MAX(qty), AVG(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY item

tests.name: null-skipping-aggregates
tests.quote: COUNT(*) 는 행을 세므로 모든 열이 NULL 인 행도 센다.
input: CREATE TABLE readings (sensor STRING, note STRING, temp INT, hum INT)
INSERT INTO readings VALUES ('s1', 'ok', 20, NULL), ('s1', '', 0, NULL), ('s2', NULL, NULL, NULL)
INSERT INTO readings VALUES (NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL), ('s2', 'NULL', -4, NULL), ('s1', 'ok', 7, NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(sensor), COUNT(note), COUNT(temp), COUNT(hum) FROM readings
SELECT SUM(temp), MIN(temp), MAX(temp), AVG(temp), SUM(hum), MIN(hum), MAX(hum), AVG(hum) FROM readings
SELECT MIN(note), MAX(note), MIN(sensor), MAX(sensor) FROM readings
SELECT sensor, COUNT(*), COUNT(temp), SUM(temp), AVG(hum) FROM readings GROUP BY sensor
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM readings WHERE note IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(note) FROM readings WHERE temp = 0 OR note = ''

tests.name: empty-results
tests.quote: 통과한 행이 없어도 이 그룹은 있고 결과는 언제나 한 행이다.
input: CREATE TABLE orders (shop STRING, amount INT)
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(amount), SUM(amount), AVG(amount), MIN(shop), MAX(amount) FROM orders
SELECT shop, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY shop
INSERT INTO orders VALUES ('a', 10), ('b', NULL), (NULL, 5)
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount), MAX(shop) FROM orders WHERE amount > 100
SELECT shop, SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 GROUP BY shop
SELECT shop, SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 GROUP BY shop ORDER BY shop DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders LIMIT 0
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE shop = NULL LIMIT 3
SELECT shop, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY shop LIMIT 10
SELECT SUM(amount), AVG(amount) FROM orders WHERE shop = 'b'

tests.name: three-valued-where
tests.quote: WHERE 가 있으면 조건이 참인 행만 그룹과 집계에 쓰고 거짓이나 알 수 없음인 행은 버린다.
input: CREATE TABLE flags (id INT, a INT, b INT, s STRING)
INSERT INTO flags VALUES (6, 0, NULL, 'y'), (7, NULL, 1, 'x'), (8, NULL, 0, NULL), (9, NULL, NULL, '')
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE a = 1 AND b = 1 GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE a = 1 OR b = 1 GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE NOT (a = 1 AND b = 1) GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE NOT a = 1 AND b = 1 OR s = 'y' GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE a = 1 OR NOT a = 1 GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE b <> 1 GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE b = NULL OR b <> NULL GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE NOT NOT b IS NULL GROUP BY id
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE s IS NOT NULL AND NOT (s = 'x' OR s = '') GROUP BY id
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(b) FROM flags WHERE (a = 0 OR b = 0) AND NOT s = 'x'
SELECT id FROM flags WHERE NOT (b = 1 OR a = 1) GROUP BY id

tests.name: value-ordering
tests.quote: 한쪽이 다른 쪽의 앞부분이면 짧은 쪽이 앞선다.
input: CREATE TABLE words (w STRING, n INT)
SELECT w, n FROM words GROUP BY w, n
SELECT MIN(w), MAX(w), MIN(n), MAX(n) FROM words
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM words WHERE w < 'a'
SELECT w FROM words WHERE w >= 'ab' AND w <= 'b' GROUP BY w
SELECT w FROM words WHERE w > 'z' GROUP BY w
SELECT n, COUNT(*) FROM words WHERE n < 2 GROUP BY n
SELECT n FROM words WHERE n >= -1 AND n <> 10 GROUP BY n

tests.name: null-and-empty-groups
tests.quote: 그룹을 나눌 때는 NULL 과 NULL 을 같은 값으로 보고 NULL 과 빈 문자열은 다른 값으로 본다.
input: CREATE TABLE tickets (team STRING, tag STRING, hours INT)
INSERT INTO tickets VALUES ('ops', '', 3), (NULL, 'NULL', 2), ('ops', NULL, 4), ('', 'bug', 1)
INSERT INTO tickets VALUES (NULL, NULL, 5), ('dev', 'bug', NULL), ('', '', 6), ('ops', NULL, 7), ('NULL', 'bug', 8)
SELECT team, COUNT(*), SUM(hours) FROM tickets GROUP BY team
SELECT tag, COUNT(*) FROM tickets GROUP BY tag
SELECT team, tag, COUNT(*), MAX(hours) FROM tickets GROUP BY team, tag
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE team = NULL
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(team) FROM tickets WHERE team = ''
SELECT tag, COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE team IS NULL GROUP BY tag

tests.name: group-column-order
tests.quote: 그룹 열이 SELECT 목록에 없어도 기본 순서는 그 열로 정한다.
input: CREATE TABLE visits (city STRING, day INT, device STRING, n INT)
INSERT INTO visits VALUES ('seoul', 2, 'web', 5), ('busan', 1, 'app', 3), ('seoul', 1, 'app', 4), ('busan', 2, 'web', 1)
INSERT INTO visits VALUES ('seoul', NULL, 'web', 2), (NULL, 1, 'web', 6), ('busan', -3, NULL, 7), ('seoul', 10, 'app', 8)
SELECT city, day, SUM(n) FROM visits GROUP BY day, city
SELECT SUM(n), device FROM visits GROUP BY device, city
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits GROUP BY day
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM visits GROUP BY city, device ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

tests.name: order-by-keys
tests.quote: NULLS FIRST 와 NULLS LAST 는 ASC 인지 DESC 인지와 상관없이 자리를 정한다.
input: CREATE TABLE products (cat STRING, name STRING, price INT, stock INT)
INSERT INTO products VALUES ('pen', 'p1', NULL, 5), ('pen', 'p2', NULL, 0), ('ink', 'i1', 120, NULL), ('ink', 'i2', 80, 2)
INSERT INTO products VALUES ('pad', 'd1', NULL, NULL), ('cup', 'c1', 50, 9), (NULL, 'x1', 200, 1), ('box', 'b1', 10, 5)
SELECT cat, MAX(price) FROM products GROUP BY cat ORDER BY MAX(price)
SELECT cat, MAX(price) FROM products GROUP BY cat ORDER BY MAX(price) DESC
SELECT cat, MAX(price) FROM products GROUP BY cat ORDER BY MAX(price) ASC NULLS FIRST
SELECT cat, MAX(price) FROM products GROUP BY cat ORDER BY MAX(price) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
SELECT cat, SUM(stock), MIN(price) FROM products GROUP BY cat ORDER BY SUM( stock ) DESC, MIN(price) NULLS FIRST
SELECT cat, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY cat ORDER BY cat DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT cat, COUNT(price) FROM products GROUP BY cat ORDER BY COUNT(price), cat DESC NULLS LAST

tests.name: average-rounding
tests.quote: 가장 가까운 수가 둘이면 0 에서 먼 쪽을 고른다.
input: CREATE TABLE nums (g STRING, v INT)
INSERT INTO nums VALUES ('m', 0), ('m', 0), ('m', NULL), ('n', -2), ('n', -1)
SELECT g, COUNT(v), SUM(v), AVG(v) FROM nums GROUP BY g
SELECT g, AVG(v) FROM nums GROUP BY g ORDER BY AVG(v) DESC
SELECT COUNT(v), SUM(v), AVG(v) FROM nums WHERE g = 'e' OR g = 'f' OR g = 'h'
SELECT AVG(v) FROM nums WHERE g = 'b' OR g = 'j'

SELECT acct FROM ledger GROUP BY acct LIMIT 1000000001
